Communities.title: समुदाय आणि योजना

Communities.quote: "२४ फेब्रुवारी २०१९ रोजी मा. पंतप्रधान श्री नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या हस्ते शुभारंभ. १ डिसेंबर २०१८ पासून कार्यान्वित. पात्र शेतकरी कुटुंबांना उत्पन्न सहाय्य प्रदान करते."
Communities.pmKisanDesc: पीएम-किसान ही एक शासकीय योजना आहे जी भारतातील लहान आणि अल्पभूधारक शेतकऱ्यांना आर्थिक सहाय्य प्रदान करते. या उपक्रमांतर्गत, पात्र शेतकऱ्यांना त्यांच्या बँक खात्यात थेट तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये वार्षिक ₹६,००० मिळतात.
Communities.footerNote: * माहिती अधिकृत पीएम किसान युट्यूब चॅनेल आणि शासकीय स्रोतांवर आधारित आहे.

kkms.title: किसान नॉलेज मॅनेजमेंट सिस्टम
kkms.description: किसान नॉलेज मॅनेजमेंट सिस्टम ही कृषी मंत्रालयाची एक पहल आहे जी शेतकऱ्यांना टोल-फ्री क्रमांक, ऑनलाइन फोरम आणि उपयुक्त शेती-विशिष्ट माहिती यासारख्या सेवा प्रदान करते.

pmKisanScheme.description: पीएम-किसान योजना लहान आणि अल्पभूधारक शेतकऱ्यांच्या (SMFs) आर्थिक गरजा पूर्ण करण्यासाठी वार्षिक ₹६००० चे थेट उत्पन्न सहाय्य प्रदान करते, जे तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये हस्तांतरित केले जाते.

CropDetail.riskCardDesc: सूक्ष्म हवामान, रोग इतिहास, पानांचे आरोग्य आणि फेनॉलॉजी यांचा समावेश असलेला बहुस्तरीय धोका निर्देशांक
CropDetail.noRiskData: अद्याप कोणतेही धोका मूल्यमापन उपलब्ध नाही. रिअल-टाइम मूल्यमापनासाठी वरील बटणावर क्लिक करा.
CropDetail.scoutedZonesDesc: शेत पाहणी दरम्यान गोळा केलेले बहु-दृष्टिकोन छायाचित्र पुरावे.
CropDetail.noScans: अद्याप कोणतेही स्कॅन नोंदवले नाही. पुरावे गोळा करण्यासाठी माझी पिके टॅब वापरा.
CropDetail.workPlanDesc: ICAR, कृषी विद्यापीठे आणि एग्रीशील्ड धोक्यांमधून मिळालेले कृषी मार्गदर्शन.
CropDetail.noInterventions: तुमच्या कार्य योजनेमध्ये कोणतेही सक्रिय उपाय नाहीत. शिफारसींसाठी वर 'सल्ला तयार करा' वर क्लिक करा.
CropDetail.allChecksClearDesc: सध्याच्या वाढ आणि हवामानासाठी कोणतीही सक्रिय चिंता आढळली नाही.
CropDetail.run360AssessmentDesc: सूक्ष्म हवामान, व्हिज्युअल स्कॅन आणि वाढ टप्प्यावर आधारित स्वयंचलित धोका मूल्यमापन करा.
CropDetail.advisoryTitle: कृतीयोग्य सल्ला आणि एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन (IPM)
CropDetail.advisoryDesc: ICAR आणि CIB&RC मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वांद्वारे प्रमाणित अचूक कृषी शिफारसी
CropDetail.zoneScoutingDesc: या पीक चक्रासाठी मॉनिटरिंग झोनवर केलेले निदान स्कॅन
CropDetail.noDiagnosticScans: या पिकासाठी अद्याप कोणतेही स्कॅन नोंदवलेले नाही.

wheat-rust.name: Wheat Rust
wheat-rust.description: Fungal disease affecting wheat stems, leaves, and grains.
wheat-rust.favorableConditions: Warm days and cool nights with dew.

rice-blast.name: Rice Blast
rice-blast.impact: Severe destruction of the entire crop.

corn-smut.name: Common Smut
corn-smut.description: Fungal disease causing galls on plants.
corn-smut.favorableConditions: Hot, dry weather followed by rain.

heart-rot.name: Heart Rot
heart-rot.description: Fungal decay of the inner leaves.

citrus-canker.name: Citrus Canker
citrus-canker.description: Bacterial spots on fruit and leaves.

NAA.name: NAA 4.5% SL
NAA.description: Prevents flower and fruit drop in a wide range of crops.
NAA.longDescription: NAA (Naphthalene Acetic Acid) 4.5% SL is a synthetic plant hormone in the auxin family. It is primarily used to prevent the premature shedding of flowers, squares, and bolls, thereby improving fruit set and overall yield. It is effective in crops like cotton, tomatoes, and mangoes.
features: Prevents flower and fruit drop
Improves fruit set and retention
Enhances overall crop yield
Promotes root growth in cuttings
Suitable for foliar application

usage.tomato: 20-40 ml in 1000 L water per ha (at flowering and fruit set)
usage.cotton: 222-444 ml in 1000 L water per ha (3 sprays from square formation)
usage.mango: 15 ml formulation per 100 L water (pre-harvest spray)

Abamectin.name: Abamectin 1.9% EC
Abamectin.description: Effective against mites and leaf miners in a variety of crops.
Abamectin.longDescription: Abamectin 1.9% EC is a mixture of avermectins, producing toxic effects in insects and mites by stimulating the release of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), an inhibitory neurotransmitter. It provides excellent control of spider mites and leaf miners in crops like roses, grapes, apples, and tomatoes.
features: Effective against red spider mites and leaf miners
Acts through contact and stomach action
Recommended for use on roses, grapes, apples, and tomatoes
Provides long-lasting protection with a short waiting period
Rapidly degrades on plant surfaces and in soil

usage.rose: 0.025-0.05% solution in 5000 L water per ha (3 days waiting period)
usage.grapes: 0.75 ml/L water in 500-1000 L water per ha (3 days waiting period)
usage.apple: 0.05% solution, 6-7 L water per tree (7 days waiting period)
usage.tomato: 450-600 ml in 500 L water per ha (3 days waiting period)

Acephate.name: Acephate 75% SP
Acephate.description: Broad-spectrum systemic insecticide for sucking and chewing pests.
Acephate.longDescription: Acephate 75% SP is a soluble powder that acts as a systemic and contact insecticide. It is absorbed by leaves and roots, providing effective control against a wide range of pests including jassids, bollworms, aphids, and stem borers in crops like cotton, rice, and safflower.
features: Systemic action for long-lasting control
Effective against both sucking and chewing insects
Water-soluble for easy application
Suitable for cotton, paddy, and safflower
Reduces pest populations quickly

usage.cotton_jassids: 292 g a.i./ha (390 g formulation) in 500-1000 L water (15 days waiting)
usage.cotton_bollworms: 584 g a.i./ha (780 g formulation) in 500-1000 L water (15 days waiting)
usage.safflower_aphids: 584 g a.i./ha (780 g formulation) in 500-1000 L water (15 days waiting)
usage.rice_pests: 500-750 g a.i./ha (666-1000 g formulation) in 300-500 L water (15 days waiting)

Acetamiprid.name: Acetamiprid 20% SP
Acetamiprid.description: Systemic insecticide for effective control of sap-feeding insects.
Acetamiprid.longDescription: Acetamiprid 20% SP is a systemic, neonicotinoid insecticide that acts on the central nervous system of insects, causing paralysis and death. It is highly effective against aphids, jassids, thrips, and whiteflies in a variety of crops including cotton, cabbage, okra, chilli, and rice.
features: Powerful systemic and translaminar activity
Controls a broad spectrum of sucking pests
Quick knockdown effect
Safe to beneficial insects when used as directed
Compatible with most IPM programs

usage.cotton_aphids_jassids: 10 g a.i./ha (50 g formulation) in 500-600 L water (15 days waiting)
usage.cotton_whiteflies: 20 g a.i./ha (100 g formulation) in 500-600 L water (15 days waiting)
usage.cabbage_aphids: 15 g a.i./ha (75 g formulation) in 500-600 L water (7 days waiting)
usage.okra_aphids: 15 g a.i./ha (75 g formulation) in 500-600 L water (3 days waiting)
usage.chilli_thrips: 10-20 g a.i./ha (50-100 g formulation) in 500-600 L water (3 days waiting)
usage.rice_bph: 10-20 g a.i./ha (50-100 g formulation) in 500-600 L water (7 days waiting)

AluminumPhosphide.name: Aluminum Phosphide 56%
AluminumPhosphide.description: A highly effective fumigant for stored grain pest control.
AluminumPhosphide.longDescription: Aluminum Phosphide 56% is a solid fumigant that reacts with moisture in the air to release phosphine gas. It is used to control a broad spectrum of stored grain pests like weevils, borers, and beetles in cereals, pulses, oilseeds, and spices, as well as for rodent control in burrows.
features: Highly effective against all stages of stored grain pests
Penetrates deep into grain stacks
Available in tablet and pouch formulations
Kills insects without leaving residues on grain
Also used for rodent burrow fumigation

usage.cereals_pulses: 3 tablets (3g) per ton or 150g/100m³, exposure 5-7 days, aeration 48 hrs
usage.oilseeds_spices: 3 tablets per ton or 225g/100m³, exposure 5 days, aeration 48 hrs
usage.godowns: 14 tablets/1000m³ or 150g/100m³, exposure 72 hrs, aeration 24 hrs

Brodifacoum.name: Brodifacoum 0.005% BB
Brodifacoum.description: A potent, single-feed anticoagulant rodenticide for field and premises.
Brodifacoum.longDescription: Brodifacoum 0.005% BB is a powerful anticoagulant rodenticide. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of Vitamin K, essential for blood clotting, leading to the death of rodents from internal hemorrhaging. It is a single-feed bait, effective against a wide range of rats, bandicoots, and mice in agricultural, commercial, and residential settings.
features: Effective as a single-dose bait
Controls a wide variety of rodent species
Ready-to-use block formulation
Ideal for use in and around buildings and fields
Palatable bait matrix

usage.field_rats: One bait block (20g) per baiting station as single feed
usage.residential: Place in and around premises, cold storage, godowns, warehouses

Chlorantraniliprole.name: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC
Chlorantraniliprole.description: Targets lepidopteran pests by disrupting their muscle contraction.
Chlorantraniliprole.longDescription: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC belongs to the anthranilic diamide class of insecticides. It works by activating the ryanodine receptors in insects, leading to uncontrolled muscle contraction, paralysis, and death. It is highly effective against stem borers, fruit borers, and caterpillars in crops like rice, cotton, and vegetables.
features: Excellent control of lepidopteran pests
Acts on insect muscle systems, unique mode of action
Long-lasting residual control
Safe to mammals and beneficial insects
Larvicidal and ovicidal properties

usage.rice: 30 g a.i./ha (150 ml) in 500 L water (47 days waiting)
usage.cabbage: 10 g a.i./ha (50 ml) in 500 L water (3 days waiting)
usage.cotton: 30 g a.i./ha (150 ml) in 500 L water (9 days waiting)
usage.tomato: 30 g a.i./ha (150 ml) in 500 L water (3 days waiting)
usage.chilli: 30 g a.i./ha (150 ml) in 500 L water (3 days waiting)
usage.brinjal: 40 g a.i./ha (200 ml) in 500-750 L water (22 days waiting)

Cypermethrin.name: Cypermethrin 10% EC
Cypermethrin.description: A fast-acting, broad-spectrum insecticide for diverse crops.
Cypermethrin.longDescription: Cypermethrin 10% EC is a synthetic pyrethroid insecticide that acts on the nervous system of insects, providing quick knockdown and kill. It is effective against a wide range of chewing and sucking pests, including bollworms, diamondback moths, fruit borers, and jassids in crops such as cotton, cabbage, okra, brinjal, and wheat.
features: Rapid knockdown and strong repellent action
Broad-spectrum activity
Effective against a wide range of field pests
Stable in sunlight, providing good residual activity
Suitable for integration with other pest management practices

usage.cotton: 50-70 g a.i./ha (550-760 ml) in 150-1000 L water (7 days waiting)
usage.cabbage: 60-70 g a.i./ha (650-760 ml) in 100-400 L water (7 days waiting)
usage.okra: 50-70 g a.i./ha (550-760 ml) in 150-400 L water (3 days waiting)
usage.brinjal: 50-70 g a.i./ha (550-760 ml) in 150-400 L water (3 days waiting)
usage.wheat: 50 g a.i./ha (550 ml) in 500-800 L water (14 days waiting)

Deltamethrin.name: Deltamethrin 2.8% EC
Deltamethrin.description: High-potency insecticide for agriculture and public health.
Deltamethrin.longDescription: Deltamethrin 2.8% EC is a highly potent synthetic pyrethroid insecticide. It disrupts the nervous system of insects, causing immediate paralysis. It is used in agriculture to control bollworms, leaf folders, thrips, and borers, and in public health for mosquito control. Its high activity means lower dosage rates are required.
features: Extremely high insecticidal activity
Effective at very low doses
Used for both crop protection and public health
Provides rapid knockdown and good residual effect
Effective against a wide range of insect pests

usage.cotton: 12.5 g a.i./ha (500 ml) in 400-600 L water
usage.tea_thrips: 3-4 g a.i./ha (120-150 ml) in 400-600 L water (3 days waiting)
usage.okra: 10-15 g a.i./ha (400-600 ml) in 400-600 L water (1 day waiting)
usage.chilli: 10-12.5 g a.i./ha (400-500 ml) in 400-600 L water (5 days waiting)
usage.groundnut: 12.5 g a.i./ha (500 ml) in 400-600 L water (3 days waiting)
usage.public_health_mosquito: Thermal fogging 0.5 g a.i./ha or ULV 0.5 g a.i./ha

Imidacloprid.name: Imidacloprid 70% WG
Imidacloprid.description: A systemic insecticide for long-lasting control of sucking pests.
Imidacloprid.longDescription: Imidacloprid 70% WG is a systemic insecticide from the neonicotinoid group. It is absorbed by plants and moves through the vascular system, providing long-lasting protection against sap-feeding insects. It is highly effective against jassids, aphids, thrips, and whiteflies in cotton, rice, vegetables, and other crops.
features: Powerful systemic action
Provides long-term protection (up to several weeks)
Highly effective against sucking insects
Water-dispersible granule for easy mixing
Reduced risk to the environment compared to broad-spectrum sprays

usage.cotton: 21-24.5 g a.i./ha (30-35 g) in 375-500 L water (7 days waiting)
usage.rice: 21-24.5 g a.i./ha (30-35 g) in 300-375 L water (7 days waiting)
usage.okra: 21-24.5 g a.i./ha (30-35 g) in 300-375 L water (3 days waiting)
usage.cucumber: 24.5 g a.i./ha (35 g) in 500 L water (5 days waiting)
usage.tomato: 35 g a.i./ha (50 g) in 500 L water (5 days waiting)
usage.potato: 63 g a.i./ha (90 g) in 500 L water (30 days waiting)

Thiamethoxam.name: Thiamethoxam 25% WG
Thiamethoxam.description: Systemic insecticide with rapid action for comprehensive crop protection.
Thiamethoxam.longDescription: Thiamethoxam 25% WG is a second-generation neonicotinoid insecticide with excellent systemic and translaminar activity. It works by interfering with nicotinic acetylcholine receptors in the insect nervous system. It is effective against a broad spectrum of sucking and some chewing pests in rice, cotton, vegetables, and mangoes.
features: Broad-spectrum control of sucking pests
Excellent systemic and translaminar movement
Rapid uptake by plants
Long residual activity
Can be applied as foliar spray, drench, or seed treatment

usage.rice: 25 g a.i./ha (100 g) in 500-750 L water (14 days waiting)
usage.cotton_jassid: 25 g a.i./ha (100 g) in 500-750 L water (21 days waiting)
usage.cotton_whitefly: 50 g a.i./ha (200 g) in 500-750 L water (21 days waiting)
usage.okra: 25 g a.i./ha (100 g) in 500-1000 L water (5 days waiting)
usage.mango: 25 g a.i./ha (100 g) in 1000 L water (30 days waiting)
usage.wheat: 12.5 g a.i./ha (50 g) in 500 L water (21 days waiting)

AcephateImida.name: Acephate 50% + Imidacloprid 1.8% SP
AcephateImida.description: A powerful combination for controlling both sucking and borer pests.
AcephateImida.longDescription: This combination product harnesses the systemic and contact action of Imidacloprid with the broad-spectrum activity of Acephate. It provides a comprehensive solution for complex pest infestations, effectively managing jassids, aphids, thrips, whiteflies, and bollworms in crops like cotton, chilli, and paddy.
features: Dual mode of action for resistance management
Controls a wide spectrum of sucking pests and bollworms
Synergistic effect for enhanced pest control
Ideal for crops with multiple pest complexes
Water-soluble powder for easy application

usage.cotton: 518 g a.i./ha (1000 g) in 500 L water (40 days waiting)
usage.rice: 518 g a.i./ha (1000 g) in 500 L water
usage.sugarcane: 1250+45 g a.i./ha (2500 ml) in 500 L water (123 days waiting)
usage.chilli: 518 g a.i./ha (1000 g) in 500 L water (3 days waiting)

ChlLambda.name: Chlorantraniliprole 9.3% + Lambda-cyhalothrin 4.6% ZC
ChlLambda.description: A potent mix of diamide and pyrethroid for rapid and residual control.
ChlLambda.longDescription: This combination formulation contains Chlorantraniliprole (a ryanodine receptor modulator) and Lambda-cyhalothrin (a sodium channel modulator). It provides both quick knockdown and long-lasting residual control of a wide range of pests including fruit borers, bollworms, leaf folders, jassids, and beetles in crops like pigeon pea, cotton, brinjal, and maize.
features: Two powerful modes of action
Provides rapid knockdown (Lambda-cyhalothrin) and long residual (Chlorantraniliprole)
Broad-spectrum control of lepidopteran and sucking pests
Effective resistance management tool
Protects yield and quality

usage.pigeon_pea: 30 g a.i./ha (200 ml) in 500 L water (18 days waiting)
usage.cotton: 37.5 g a.i./ha (250 ml) in 500 L water (20 days waiting)
usage.brinjal: 28 g a.i./ha (200 ml) in 500 L water (5 days waiting)
usage.okra: 28 g a.i./ha (200 ml) in 500 L water (3 days waiting)
usage.rice: 28-35 g a.i./ha (200-250 ml) in 500 L water (53 days waiting)
usage.soybean: 28 g a.i./ha (200 ml) in 500 L water (41 days waiting)
usage.maize: 35 g a.i./ha (250 ml) in 500 L water (36 days waiting)

LambdaCS.name: Lambda-cyhalothrin 9.7% CS
LambdaCS.description: A microencapsulated formulation for effective mosquito control.
LambdaCS.longDescription: Lambda-cyhalothrin 9.7% CS is a public health insecticide formulated for indoor residual spraying (IRS). Its microencapsulation technology provides a safer and longer-lasting residual effect on various wall surfaces. It is specifically recommended for controlling mosquitoes that transmit malaria, dengue, and other vector-borne diseases.
features: Microencapsulated for enhanced safety and residual life
Used for Indoor Residual Spraying (IRS)
Effective against Anopheles, Aedes, and Culex mosquitoes
Long-lasting efficacy on porous and non-porous surfaces
Approved for public health programs

usage.malaria_control: 25 mg a.i./sq.m (12.5 ml/500 sq.m) in 10 L water
usage.moderate_infestation: 20 mg a.i./sq.m (4 ml/L water) spray solution 50 ml/sq.m
usage.high_infestation: 25 mg a.i./sq.m (5 ml/L water) spray solution 50 ml/sq.m

Temephos.name: Temephos 1% GR
Temephos.description: A larvicide for controlling mosquito breeding in water bodies.
Temephos.longDescription: Temephos 1% GR is an organophosphate larvicide used in public health programs to control mosquito larvae. It is applied to breeding habitats such as stagnant water, ponds, drains, and containers to prevent the emergence of adult mosquitoes. It is highly effective against Aedes, Anopheles, and Culex species.
features: Specifically targets mosquito larvae
Prevents adult mosquito emergence
Ideal for use in drinking water storage containers (at recommended doses)
Available in easy-to-apply granule form
An essential tool in Integrated Vector Management (IVM)

usage.highly_polluted: 200-500 g a.i./ha (20-50 kg/ha) for drains, cesspits
usage.moderately_polluted: 100-200 g a.i./ha (10-20 kg/ha) for marshes, swamps
usage.clean_water: 50-100 g a.i./ha (5-10 kg/ha) for ponds, lakes
usage.cyclops_control: 0.5-1.0 g a.i. (5-10 g) for ponds, step wells

TransfluthrinLV.name: Transfluthrin 0.88% Liquid Vaporizer
TransfluthrinLV.description: A ready-to-use liquid vaporizer for mosquito-free homes.
TransfluthrinLV.longDescription: This is a ready-to-use household insecticide in a liquid vaporizer format. It contains Transfluthrin, a fast-acting pyrethroid that effectively repels and kills mosquitoes (Aedes, Anopheles, Culex) and houseflies. It provides a convenient and continuous protection system for indoor use.
features: Ready-to-use liquid vaporizer
Provides continuous protection for up to 30-60 nights
Effectively controls and repels mosquitoes
Odorless and non-staining
Ideal for bedrooms and living areas

usage.indoor: Use with standard liquid vaporizer machine, one refill provides 30-45 nights protection
usage.area: Effective for rooms up to 300-400 sq.ft

PrallethrinLV.name: Prallethrin 0.65% Liquid Vaporizer
PrallethrinLV.description: A fast-acting liquid vaporizer for immediate mosquito protection.
PrallethrinLV.longDescription: This liquid vaporizer contains Prallethrin, a synthetic pyrethroid known for its rapid knockdown effect against mosquitoes. It is highly effective in eliminating mosquitoes quickly and providing a comfortable environment. It is safe for use in homes when used as directed.
features: Fast-acting formula for quick knockdown
Effective against mosquitoes and other flying insects
Provides continuous protection
Easy to use with standard liquid vaporizer devices
Pleasant fragrance for a comfortable atmosphere

usage.indoor: Use with standard liquid vaporizer machine, one refill provides 30-45 nights protection
usage.area: Effective for rooms up to 300-400 sq.ft

RupiyaKuber.name: Rupiya Kuber
RupiyaKuber.description: A natural liquid manure supplement providing balanced potassium, carbon, and magnesium to the crop.
RupiyaKuber.longDescription: It's a natural liquid manure supplement which provides balanced amounts of potassium, carbon and magnesium to the crop. Increases productivity and quality of crops by enhancing the process of photosynthesis and pollen germination.
features: Increases productivity and quality of crops
Enhances photosynthesis and pollen germination
Provides natural micronutrition to the crop
Helps in fruit and flower development

MiticideViricideCombo.name: Miticide + Lysorus Viricide Combo
MiticideViricideCombo.description: A powerful combination of miticide and viricide to protect crops from mites and viral diseases.
MiticideViricideCombo.longDescription: Miticide + Lysorus Viricide Combo provides dual protection against harmful mites and viral infections in crops.
features: Effective control of mites and viral diseases
Improves overall plant health

TapasSiliconAdjuvant.name: Tapas Silicon Adjuvant
TapasSiliconAdjuvant.description: A silicon-based adjuvant that enhances pesticide efficiency and strengthens plant defense.
TapasSiliconAdjuvant.longDescription: Tapas Silicon Adjuvant improves the effectiveness of pesticides and foliar sprays.
features: Enhances effectiveness of pesticides and fertilizers
Improves spray coverage and absorption
